sections.Profile:
Join International Rescue and take on its nemesis, The Hood, in Homepin Ltd's licensed game based on Thunderbirds , the 1960s British puppet series. Released in January 2018 as the company's first licensed table, it puts Tracy Island on the playfield, complete with a retracting swimming pool and palm trees.
